item.text: The column is selected and the Format Cells dialog is open. I’m setting its number format code to show exactly two decimal places.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "DISPLAY=:0 python3 - <<'PY'
import pyautogui, time
# Click format code field, replace with 0.00, confirm dialog
pyautogui.click(830,762)
pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl','a')
pyautogui.write('0.00', interval=0.02)
time.sleep(0.2)
pyautogui.click(1267,838)
time.sleep(0.8)
# Save file
pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl','s')
time.sleep(0.5)
print('done')
PY"
